name: Superhero
definition: A comic-book character record. Each row of the superhero table describes one superhero through a display name, full name, gender, eye/hair/skin colours, race, publisher, moral alignment, height and weight.
scope: Character-level analysis of the superhero universe.

name: Superhero Name
definition: The popular display name of a superhero, e.g. '3-D Man' or 'Copycat'. It is the name normally used when a question asks 'which superhero' or asks to list superhero names.
scope: Identifying or listing superheroes by their popular name.

name: Full Name
definition: The civilian identity or real full name of a superhero, e.g. 'Charles Chandler' for 3-D Man and 'Emil Blonsky' for Abomination. It is not the same concept as the superhero name.
scope: Identifying superheroes by their real name; disambiguating duplicated superhero names.

name: Gender
definition: The gender category of a superhero, stored as a numeric code in the superhero record and labelled in the gender table: 1 = Male, 2 = Female, 3 = N/A.
scope: Gender-based filtering, grouping and counting of superheroes.

name: Publisher
definition: The publishing company that publishes a superhero (e.g. Marvel Comics, DC Comics, Dark Horse Comics, Star Trek). A publisher has an identifier and a verbatim company name and is referenced from each superhero record.

name: Race
definition: The fictional species or race of a superhero, stored as free-text names such as 'Mutant', 'Human / Radiation' or 'Alien', referenced by code from the superhero record. The value '-' marks an unspecified race.

name: Alignment
definition: The moral alignment of a superhero: 1 = Good, 2 = Bad, 3 = Neutral, 4 = N/A. It distinguishes heroes and villains at the moral level.

name: Villain
definition: A character of the superhero universe whose alignment value is 'Bad'. It is a subset of the alignment value domain, not a separate entity with its own table.

name: Colour
definition: A shared colour value list referenced by three distinct role columns: eye colour, hair colour and skin colour. Colour id 1 is the sentinel 'No Colour', meaning an unspecified colour rather than white.
scope: Interpreting colour labels and the 'No Colour' sentinel across the three colour roles.

name: Eye Colour
definition: The eye colour of a superhero, referencing the shared colour list. A value of 'No Colour' means the eye colour is unspecified or absent.
scope: Eye-colour filtering, including questions about superheroes with no eye colour.

name: Hair Colour
definition: The hair colour of a superhero, referencing the shared colour list. A value of 'No Colour' means the hair colour is unspecified (e.g. bald or unrecorded).

name: Skin Colour
definition: The skin colour of a superhero, referencing the shared colour list. It carries values such as Green, Blue or Red used to describe non-human characters.

name: Attribute
definition: One of six rated ability categories a superhero can be scored on: Intelligence, Strength, Speed, Durability, Power and Combat. An attribute is a rating dimension and is a different concept from a named superpower.

name: Attribute Rating
definition: The numeric score of a superhero on one attribute, on a 0-100 scale (observed values 5 to 100). There is at most one rating per superhero per attribute.
scope: Comparing, filtering and aggregating superhero ability scores.

name: Superpower
definition: A named superhuman ability from the superpower catalogue, such as 'Super Strength', 'Flight', 'Telepathy' or 'Super Speed'. Superpowers are assigned to superheroes through a many-to-many link and are distinct from numeric attribute ratings.

name: Height
definition: The height of a superhero expressed directly in centimetres, with no unit conversion required.
scope: Height filtering and comparison, e.g. height over 200 cm or within a centimetre range.

name: Weight
definition: The weight of a superhero expressed directly in kilograms, with no unit conversion required.

name: Superhero Count
definition: The number of superhero records within a scope, either overall or within a group defined by publisher, gender, alignment, attribute rating, superpower or any other filter condition.
scope: Counting superheroes for any filtered or grouped population.
